facts.fact: Sierra Loaded reports that Google Maps has partnered with the Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation (DSTI) to digitize physical addresses in Sierra Leone, with a residential digitized address system described as forthcoming.

systems.owner: DSTI and Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning

note: The post describes a high-resolution base map and states no address system, street naming or numbering.
The document concerns a business registration concession; it states nothing on this question.
The document covers land boundary harmonisation for titling; it states nothing on addressing.
The document covers land and property registration only; it states nothing on addressing.
Sierra Leone only named as a place a Beninese developer could offer a solution; nothing asked.
Digital addressing through post offices is only a proposal seeking finance.
